facts.fact: The World Bank's ISR of 25 September 2026 says INE and the Bank agreed to cut the administrative data pilot under the Angola statistical capacity project from five to three ministries, so the pilot is under way with nothing published.

AGO.note: Only a business census is added to the project; the population census cartography is stated as future and no survey results are stated published.
Nothing on control of state data.
No ICT employment figure or graduate unemployment statistic.
ENDE 2026-2032 is named only as an essential milestone; the document does not say it is being drafted, validated or adopted.
